description: This file contains utility methods for working with Order objects in the OpenMRS project, including type checking and schedule overlap detection.

classes.name: OrderUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for order type comparison and schedule overlap checks.

methods.name: isType
methods.description: Determines whether one OrderType matches or is a subtype of another, considering hierarchical relationships.

methods.name: checkScheduleOverlap
methods.description: Checks whether the schedules of two orders overlap based solely on their effective start and stop dates.
